schema.title: Response Figure Candidates Api Figures  Figure Id  Candidates Get

Box.title: Box
Box.description: A region of a page in PDF points, top-left origin.

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description:
A value a correction can pick from the figure's own source: a cell of the same table row,
or a number in the same paragraph.

CheckQueue.title: CheckQueue
CheckQueue.description: CHECKS (#19 R9): the figures that feed a KPI or screen, problems first.

CheckRow.title: CheckRow
CheckRow.description: One value to check: every figure of one filing stating it, or one rejected figure.

CheckStatus.title: CheckStatus
CheckStatus.description: Where a CHECKS row stands: its figures' check in force, or what they wait for.

Chunk.title: Chunk
Chunk.description: A Chunk with where to find it: what search returns and the source viewer highlights.

Company.title: Company
Company.description: An issuer's dossier: its filings, and its listing and last close once it has them.

CompanyFacts.title: CompanyFacts
CompanyFacts.description: An issuer's facts of the eight kinds, as the dossier lists them under its figures.

Correction.title: Correction
Correction.description: The right value, as the person gave it, parsed in Python like an extracted one.

FactDetail.title: FactDetail
FactDetail.description:
A fact as the inspector shows it (S3): in one sentence, and next to every other value
stated for its key at its date when it is a Conflict.

FactReviewRequest.title: FactReviewRequest
FactReviewRequest.description: Keep a value of a Conflict, so the dossier shows it (D5), or undo that.

FactRow.title: FactRow
FactRow.description:
One dossier row: the value shown for a kind, its parties and details (#19 R8), with every
fact stating it at its date, and each other value stated then (a Conflict).

FactSide.title: FactSide
FactSide.description: One value of a Conflict, as the inspector shows it side by side (S3b).

Figure.title: Figure
Figure.description: A financial figure Fact (#19 R5, R6): checked against its Passage before it was stored.

FigureDetail.title: FigureDetail
FigureDetail.description: A figure with its line item's title in the current label map, as the viewer names it.

FigureGrid.title: FigureGrid
FigureGrid.description: An issuer's current figures as the dossier lists them, on each basis.

FigureRow.title: FigureRow
FigureRow.description: A line item, or one breakdown of it, in one currency, by fiscal year.

FigureValue.title: FigureValue
FigureValue.description: One value a line item takes in a year, and every figure stating it, rounded or not.

LastClose.title: LastClose
LastClose.description: A share's latest close, as the dossier shows it.

Listing.title: Listing
Listing.description: A share's listing on an exchange (#26): what its closes are kept under.

NameCheck.title: NameCheck
NameCheck.description:
A CHECKS Names row (S7b): a name no rule linked to exactly one Organisation or Person,
or one a person resolved.

NameReview.title: NameReview
NameReview.description: A person's decision about what a name stands for: the one in force on it.

NameReviewRequest.title: NameReviewRequest
NameReviewRequest.description:
What a name stands for (CHECKS Names): the same as a known Organisation or Person, a new
one, or none; or undo the decision before.

NameSource.title: NameSource
NameSource.description: Where a filing writes a name: the fact naming it, and the Passage it was read from.

NameStatus.title: NameStatus
NameStatus.description: Where a CHECKS Names row stands.

NameVerdict.title: NameVerdict
NameVerdict.description: What a person decides a name stands for, in CHECKS Names.

Organisation.title: Organisation
Organisation.description:
The Organisation a filing comes from. Keyed by the ISIN the operator gives until
Listings (which own the ISIN in AGENTS.md) arrive in #24.

Party.title: Party
Party.description:
A party a fact names: as written, the full name the extractor read, and what it resolves
to; `resolved` is None until the name is linked or a person resolves it in CHECKS.

PartyKind.title: PartyKind
PartyKind.description:
What a name stands for. Organisation kinds follow the ontology (AGENTS.md); the two
aggregates stand for a company's own holders, never for an Organisation of their own.

PartyRef.title: PartyRef
PartyRef.description: An Organisation or Person a name resolves to.

Passage.title: Passage
Passage.description: The exact span a Fact cites: a table cell, or a quoted range of a paragraph.

PriceSeries.title: PriceSeries
PriceSeries.description: A share's closes, oldest first: one per session, the exchange's over a manual one.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: Why a request failed, in words a person can act on.

RejectedFact.title: RejectedFact
RejectedFact.description:
A fact the LLM proposed that its quote does not state (#19 R6). Kept with the reason,
never shown in the dossier.

Review.title: Review
Review.description:
A person's check of a figure (#19 R9). On a figure it is the check in force, so accepted or
corrected: a figure whose latest check reopened it has none.

ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest
ReviewRequest.description:
A check of one CHECKS row. A correction gives the right value one way: typed, or picked
from the figure's own source (`GET /api/figures/{id}/candidates`).

RunStep.title: RunStep
RunStep.description: The processing steps a Run records (AGENTS.md); later steps add theirs.

Sentence.title: Sentence
Sentence.description: A fact in one sentence, its value marked: `Société Alpha holds` `53 %` `of Gamma`.

StatedFact.title: StatedFact
StatedFact.description:
A Fact of one of the eight kinds other than financial figures (#24), checked against its
Passage before it was stored.

TablePart.title: TablePart
TablePart.description: Which part of a split table a Chunk is: parts of one table share `table_id`.
